description:
Render a Studio data card from a type + body. Deterministic React,
no paint. Optional live post after render. Returns run_id, image url,
and post url when posted.

aspect.description: Canvas aspect, e.g. square-ig or wide-twitter.

body.description: Card fields for that type (amount, productName, …).

output_type.description: One of the 33 Studio types from studio_templates, e.g. sale-notification.

platform.description: Connected channel if post is true: x, instagram, tiktok, linkedin, or youtube.

post.description: If true, post the finished card to a connected account. Confirm with the user first.

theme.description: dark or light. Omit to use the workspace default.

name: studio_card
